name: O3b mPower 11-13
slot_a_text: SpaceX's 109th launch of the year, 728th all time. 47th from SLC-40 this year, 19 days since the last one. The 216th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Falcon 9 is on a 332 flight success streak.
slot_b_text: B1080 has flown 28 times over 38 months. Its flights break down as 22 Starlink, two Axiom, and four others. Its quickest turnaround was 13 days. Only two cores in the fleet have flown more.
description: 3 high-throughput communications satellites in Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) built by Boeing and operated by SES.
rocket_fact: The 'Octaweb' engine arrangement is designed to protect surrounding engines if one Merlin engine explodes.
